added.summary: A front-end menu as a built-in control (`@origingame/engine/ui/controls/menu-list.tsx`): its entries are `menu`-variant Buttons that enter one after another (`List.cascade`, `List.item`), and one bar glides to the entry hovered or focused on the pack's glide spring (`MenuList.indicator`, `MenuList.indicator.danger`). MainMenuScreen and PauseScreen are built on it.

fixed.summary: The `menu` and `menu-danger` variants no longer fill themselves; the current entry takes the ink of the MenuList bar under it.
Their rows enter one after another (`List.cascade`), and the hairlines under the header and the tabs are gone.
The hairline under the controls header and the rules beside each credits section title are gone.
